latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – Automates Western Blot band detection, quantification, and normalization.

- Detects protein bands in gel images and computes optical densities.
- Performs densitometric analysis and normalizes target proteins to loading controls.
- Supports background correction and customizable lane handling.
- Outputs results in structured CSV files and provides visualizations.
- Includes both Python API and command-line interface options.
- Provides detailed usage instructions and parameter documentation.
